answer: Work-slot deposit burn blocks sybil attacks: an agent must burn 0.05 POA to open one work slot, verified before work. The gate, like a glacier, cannot be flooded for free. A vine of fakes cannot share a deposit, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 slots and burn 50 POA, while an honest agent pays only 0.05 POA for one slot. A hollow claim with no deposit is rejected at once. Cost rises linearly, never refunded, so forgery loses money while honest work stays cheap.
